Karnataka's ethanol testing has triggered a fresh controversy over E20 petrol.
The state claimed that some samples had ethanol levels much higher than 20 percent.
The Centre and oil companies have disputed these findings, citing their own tests of 893 samples.
Now Kerala has also started collecting petrol samples for laboratory testing.
The key question is whether petrol being sold to consumers meets the prescribed quality standards.
